title: Subscription Billing Leaks: Pricing, Dunning & Renewal Gaps
description: Subscription billing leaks beyond failed payments — annual plan gaps, proration errors, trial billing surprises, and leakage math.

faq.a: Revenue lost in the billing layer: failed charges, wrong plan assignments, missing annual upsells, and customers on legacy pricing.

faq.q: How do I audit subscription billing?
faq.a: Export active subs, segment by plan and tenure, check failed payment rate, and compare MRR to expected from list price.

blocks.text: Subscription billing leaks sit between product and finance. Customers stay subscribed but pay less than they should, or churn silently when cards fail.

items: Trials that convert to wrong plan tier
Tax or currency misconfiguration on invoices
